# Portrait expansion · v0.10

256 additional fictional male player portraits, generated with the built-in image generation tool. Final atlases: players-e.png, players-f.png, players-g.png, players-h.png. All remain original PNGs; portrait-crops.js supplies individually clipped source windows, including nonuniform row spacing. No real-person ethnicity inference is used. Existing art is a neutral fallback pool. New designed pools favor regional origins 85% of the time when an unused preferred face is available; every face is used before duplicates. Transfers keep the player's established portrait.

## Prompt set

Each prompt requested a square, eight-column/eight-row esports portrait atlas, 64 distinct fictional adult male players, retro pixel-painted head-and-shoulders artwork, muted jerseys, slate-gray backgrounds, no text or logos, and padding around the full head within each cell.

- players-e: varied Korean- and Chinese-inspired East Asian character designs, differing face shapes, mostly dark hairstyles with occasional dyed hair and glasses.
- players-f: European and North American character designs, including white, Black, Latino and Middle Eastern men; varied hair colors, beards, glasses and facial structures.
- players-g: additional Korean- and Chinese-inspired characters with expressive faces, varied face widths, crops, side parts, shaved heads, tied-back hair and round glasses.
- players-h: additional European and North American characters, freckled redheads, blond men, Black men with twists or short hair, Latino and Mediterranean men; mostly clean-shaven with some short beards.
